entries.name: Android emulator images
entries.hint: Per-AVD emulator data under this account. Typed delete and wipe run through avdmanager; the Relocation tab (CLA-02) moves the folder off the OS disk.
entries.impact: Cleaning this folder as a catalog path is disabled: it would destroy every AVD. Use Android emulators on Advanced scan to delete or wipe one AVD at a time.
entries.note: CLA-01: inventory and typed avdmanager actions. Relocation of this folder is CLA-02.

entries.name: iOS Simulator devices
entries.hint: Per-device simulator data under this account. It is measured for relocation; the Relocation tab moves it to another volume.
entries.impact: Cleaning is disabled: deleting this folder would destroy every simulator with its apps and data.
entries.note: Relocation-only entry (CLN-27): Move/Restore happen on the Relocation tab and replace the folder with a symlink to the copy on the destination volume.
